description: The Nydegg Bridge is the three-arch freestone bridge of 1840 to 1844, about 25 metres above the Aare, with the Nydegg church at the old-town end. The central arch is the long span, clad in blue-grey sandstone. The bear enclosure lies below the bridge and is not the subject. The Open-Meteo model is overcast and mild, about 17°C, with almost no wind and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
